name: Fangstorm
body:
School evocation [force]; Level druid 6, sorcerer/wizard 6

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range long (400 ft. + 40 ft./level)
Area 20-ft. radius, 40 ft. high
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw Fortitude half; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You cause the air to fill with glowing fangs of force that rip and tear into the flesh of anyone in the area of effect. The fangs deal 10d6 points of physical damage, and cause the wounds to bleed at a rate of 1 hp per four caster levels (max 5 hp/round). If the Fortitude save is successful, the target takes half damage and does not begin bleeding. This spell is effective against incorporeal targets, but such targets do not begin bleeding.
